hero.subtitle: The complete back-office for modern merchants. Manage products, customers, and orders — generate professional PDF invoices in seconds.

grid.label: Platform features
grid.title: Everything you need to run your business
grid.subtitle: From inventory and customer management to professional PDF receipts with digital integrity — built for modern merchants.

products.title: Product Management
products.description: Full CRUD with purchase/sale prices, color-coded margin tracking, inventory alerts and stock badges. Bulk operations with row selection.

customers.title: Customer CRM
customers.description: Manage recipients with full order history, total spend aggregation, Telegram integration badges and a slide-over detail drawer.

orders.title: Order Lifecycle
orders.description: DRAFT → CONFIRMED → CANCELLED workflow with payment status, soft-delete, order locking and idempotency keys for safe retries.

receipts.title: PDF Receipt Generation
receipts.description: Background PDF generation via BullMQ queue. 10 professional templates, SHA256 integrity hash, S3 storage and Playwright + Handlebars rendering.

analytics.title: Analytics & Dashboard
analytics.description: Revenue sparklines, order status donut, turnover by product and customer, CSV export with Redis-cached queries and date range presets.

telegramBot.title: Telegram Bot
telegramBot.description: Full shopping cart experience inside Telegram with inline buttons, quantity input, order confirmation and automatic customer creation.

howItWorks.label: How it works
howItWorks.title: Up and running in minutes
howItWorks.subtitle: No complex setup. Register, configure your branding, and start creating orders and generating receipts right away.

step1.title: Add your products & customers
step1.description: Import your catalog with prices and stock levels. Add customers manually or let the Telegram bot create them automatically on first order.

step2.title: Create and confirm orders
step2.description: Build multi-item orders with per-item pricing. Move through DRAFT → CONFIRMED. Track payment status and filter by date, status or amount.

step3.title: Generate & send receipts
step3.description: Click "Generate Receipt" — a professional PDF is created with your branding in the background. Download, print, or send directly.

telegram.label: Telegram Bot
telegram.title: Sell directly inside Telegram
telegram.description: Your customers browse products, add to cart and confirm orders without leaving Telegram. Sessions persist across restarts via Redis.

feat1.title: Full cart experience
feat1.description: Inline buttons, quantity input, stock validation, order review and confirmation flow.

feat2.title: Automatic customer creation
feat2.description: Find-or-create by Telegram user ID. Customer appears in your dashboard immediately.

feat3.title: Redis-backed sessions (4h TTL)
feat3.description: Cart state survives server restarts. Rate-limit retry handling built in.
